scientific_integrity: Proof relies on the attributed Homma--Kim smoothness criterion and self-contained quadratic-form obstruction; finite verifiers are supporting checks, not a substitute for the universal proof. Historic priority remains independently unaudited.
scientific_limitations: Finite fields of characteristic three and minimum-degree plane-filling systems only; no assertion that all geometric members of a pencil are smooth or that equivalent results cannot occur in unindexed earlier finite-geometric literature.
title: A trace obstruction to smooth nets of minimum-degree plane-filling curves in characteristic three
